sourceDatasetId.title: Source dataset ID
sourceDatasetId.description: The dataset ID that contains items with a URL field (e.g., 'graZ4sDnfcnr5rGV8').

targetRequestQueueRef.title: Target Request Queue (name or ID)
targetRequestQueueRef.description: Queue name is recommended (e.g., 'fb-url-profiles'). You can also pass an ID; the actor will resolve it to a name.

urlFieldName.title: URL field in dataset
urlFieldName.description: The field in the dataset item that holds the URL.

statusDatasetName.title: Status dataset name
statusDatasetName.description: Dataset used to store per-URL statuses and the optional run summary.

normalizeUrls.title: Normalize URLs for dedup
normalizeUrls.description: Strip tracking params and trailing slashes so duplicates deduplicate reliably.

maxItems.title: Max items to process
maxItems.description: Optional limit for smoke tests (process at most this many items).

pushRunSummaryToDataset.title: Also write summary to dataset
pushRunSummaryToDataset.description: If true, the run summary object will be appended to the status dataset.
